description:
Motorcycle Selfie Stick for INSTA360 X2/X3 Handlebar Mount Camera Holder 27.9cm-113.5cm Adjustable Length 1/4 Inch Screw
Features:
1. The selfie stick is compatible with most digital cameras, action cameras, panoramic cameras, etc., as it has a 1/4 inch standard screw
2. Designed with a 5-section telescopic tube, the action camera selfie stick can flexibly extend from 27.9cm/11 inches to 113.5cm/44.7 inchesEasily install the selfie stick onto a motorcycle or bicycle using a clamp that fits handlebars up to 32mm in diameter. Suitable for outdoor cycling, the selfie stick allows you to easily capture stunning scenery while riding. Specifications: Color: Black Material: Aluminum Alloy Minimum Length: 27.9 cm / 11 inches Maximum Length: 113.5 cm / 44.7 inchesPlease note: The camera shown in the picture is not included
Package List:
1 * Selfie Stick
1 * Handle Mounting Clip
2 * non-slip rubber pads
2 * Mini Wrench
2 * Long Screws
1 * Mount AdapterReal-time shooting of safe driving
One person can easily adopt a third-person perspective to obtain new perspective images that meet your shooting needs. Capture and record the beautiful moments of cycling
Using the Insta360 panoramic camera, the extension rod can be completely hidden in the picture

Convenient adjustment
By rotating the screw holes, you can rotate and adjust the bicycle stand; the angle can be adjusted to 120 degrees°.






Fixed Rod Bracket
① Diameter: 20-35mm. ② Diameter: 20-28mm

title: NOVO-pensel kening, Kit templat kening, kalis air, tahan lama, 3 warna, Alamiah
description:
Huraian:
Jenama: NOVO
Nama produk: Balsem kening dua hujung
Orang yang berkenaan: umum
Jenis Kulit: Umum
Kandungan bersih: 1.8g
Jangka hayat: 3 tahun
Warna produk: 01 # coklat gelap, 02 # coklat alamiah, 03 # coklat kelabu
Saiz produk: 12 * 2.5 * 2cm
Berat produk: 14.6g
Kuantiti Produk: 1
Spesifikasi:
1. [Reka bentuk dua hujung] Produk ini menggunakan reka bentuk dua hujung, satu untuk krim kening dan satu lagi untuk berus kening. Pada masa yang sama, ia menggabungkan serbuk kening, pensel kening dan baju hujan kening menjadi satu, yang lebih mudah digunakan.
2. [Tekstur halus] Tekstur krim kening adalah halus dan licin, mudah disebarkan, mudah digunakan dan berwarna sekata.
3. [Berus Kening "Jenis Bilah"] Berus kening menggunakan reka bentuk serong 45 °, yang lebih sesuai dengan bentuk kening, menjadikannya mudah untuk melukis dan mencipta kening tiruan yang halus.
4. [Kesan pemaparan warna yang baik] Warnanya penuh, warnanya kaya, pemaparan warna tinggi, dan terdapat 3 warna yang berbeza untuk dipilih,
5. [Kas Air dan Kalis Peluh] Ia menggunakan formula pembentuk filem yang cepat kering, yang cepat kering, kalis air dan kalis peluh, kalis comot, solekan tahan lama dan tidak mudah ditanggalkan.
6. [Digunakan secara meluas] Satu sapuan adalah pelbagai guna, yang boleh digunakan untuk melukis kening, melukis celak, melukis ulat sutera, melukis soket mata, dsb.
7. 【 Reka Bentuk Padat 】 Saiz kecil, mudah dibawa, sesuai untuk pelbagai majlis.
Cara menggunakan:
1. Betulkan kening, puncak kening dan hujung kening, dan tentukan arah bentuk kening.
2. Pegang kepala berus ke atas dan gunakan hujung pen untuk mengesan garis besar dan aliran rambut.
3. Selepas membentuk bentuk kening, sapu bulu rata untuk mengisi celah dengan tepat.
4. Akhir sekali, gunakan sikat kening berbentuk menara untuk menjaga kening, supaya pewarnaan pes lebih seragam dan arah aliran rambut disatukan.
Pakej Termasuk:
1 * krim kening
Nota:
Disebabkan perbezaan antara monitor yang berbeza, gambar mungkin tidak menggambarkan warna sebenar item tersebut.
Bandingkan saiz butiran dengan anda, sila benarkan ralat 1-3cm, disebabkan oleh pengukuran manual.
Sila tinggalkan mesej sebelum anda memberikan maklum balas yang buruk, jika produk mempunyai beberapa masalah.
Terima kasih atas pemahaman anda.

title: Glucosamine Gummies
description:
Glucosamine – Your Joint Cushion

Think of your joints like door hinges—when the cartilage cushion wears down, they become stiff and creaky. Glucosamine acts like oil for those hinges, rebuilding and maintaining the cartilage that absorbs impact and reduces friction. The result is smoother movement, improved flexibility, and joints that stay cushioned and mobile for an active lifestyle.

Daily Mobility Gummies are a delicious way to get in the necessary level of glucosamine that your body needs to replenish cartilage and tendon tissues around the joints while also increasing the fluid around joints to prevent their breakdown.

As the body ages, joints start to ache because of the breakdown of cartilage around the joint. For some, this creates discomfort. Cartilage breakdown is more apparent in athletes who push their bodies to the limit.

title: Never Say Never - Danielle Steel English Hardcover, #1 New York Times Bestseller, Inspiring Story for Women, Wedding Anniversary-Themed Deeply Moving Novel, Delacorte Press Publication
description:
#1 NEW YORK TIMES BESTSELLER - This deeply moving novel from Danielle Steel tells the story of a woman who finds her life turned upside down while living temporarily in the French countryside.
Oona Kelly Webster has much to be grateful for. A striking woman with red hair and green eyes, she has a loving family and a job she adores, editing a prestigious line of books. To celebrate their twenty-fifth wedding anniversary, she and her husband, Charles, have planned a visit to France.
But then Charles drops a bombshell. He has been living a lie--hiding an affair for a year--and he is leaving Oona for a younger male lover.
Although devastated, Oona decides to travel to France without Charles. She arrives in a charming village an hour outside of Paris, and settles into the house she has rented, called La Belle Florence--named after the king's mistress for whom it was built. But just as she's catching her breath, she's dealt another blow: Her company's merger will eliminate her job.
In the space of a few months, everything she nurtured for decades has slipped through her fingers. The only silver lining is that she can remain in France, where the simple life in beautiful surroundings slowly begins to heal her, as does the little white dog she rescues, and her friendly neighbor hailing from Trinidad, who delights her with his openness and warmth.
Though she does not recognize him at first, she soon realizes her neighbor is a well-known actor. As their feelings for each other begin to deepen, Oona wrestles with the risks of opening her heart again--especially to a younger, very famous man.
Never Say Never is an inspiring novel about a woman who finds a second chance at happiness and love, all because she understands the importance of being brave enough to stay open to change.

-5 nights single room accommodation
-5 artisan studio visits
-2 hands-on workshops
-all breakfasts and lunches
-Welcome Dinner and Farewell Dinner
-all transportation, activity fees, and local guide
-Concierge assistance (pre-trip and during the tour)
The total trip cost is $2600 (excludes airfare to/from Japan but includes domestic flights between from Osaka to Naha). The $2100 balance is split into two payments invoiced for November 22nd and February 22nd.  (Online payments through Venmo or Wise are OK; otherwise by check to avoid large fees.)  $200 of the deposit is non-refundable.

REFUND POLICY:
75% back for cancellations made before October 22, 2025
50% back for cancellations made before January 22, 2026
No refunds for cancellations made after January 22,2026
Participants are expected to get traveler's insurance.

title: Bút Đo PH Đo Nước Bể Cá, Đo Nước Sạch Kèm 3 Gói Hiệu Chỉnh
description:
*Bút đã được hiệu chỉnh sẵn có thể sử dụng ngay không cần hiệu chỉnh lại

*Chi tiết sản phẩm:
Bút đo pH dụng cụ hỗ trợ xác định (độ chua hoặc độ kiềm) trong nước - dung dịch. Các phép đo này rất quan trọng đối với nhiều ứng dụng trong nuôi trồng thủy sản,sinh vật cảnh, hồ bơi, nông nghiệp, y học, sinh học, hóa học, khoa học thực phẩm, khoa học môi trường, hải dương học, dinh dưỡng, xử lý nước và lọc nước các lĩnh vực khác. Bút đo độ PH này được sử dụng rộng rãi trong sản xuất đo lường ph trong nuôi trồng thủy sản, quản lý bể bơi hồ chứa, canh tác nông nghiệp, sản xuất công nghiệp, phòng thí nghiệm, cơ sở kiểm soát chất lượng và giáo dục.
*Màu sắc: Vàng
-Chất liệu: Nhựa tổng hợp
-Mẫu mã: Cầm tay, dùng pin 2 x 1.5V
-Dòng sản phẩm: Máy do pH, bút do pH nước
-Phạm vi đo chỉ số pH: 0.00-14.00 PH, dộ chính xác + -0,05 pH
-Nhiệt độ hoạt động: 0-80°C
-Chiều dài: 15cm
-Trọng lượng : 48gr

CÁCH SỬ DỤNG MÁY ĐO PH CẦM TAY
1.Tháo nắp bảo vệ bút
2. Đầu tiên rửa sạch điện cực bằng nước sạch và làm khô bằng giấy lọc.
3. Bật đồng hồ ON bằng cách nhấn phím ON / OFF.
4. Nhúng bút đo độ pH vào dung dịch cần đo chìm hết phần đầu cực
5. Khuấy nhẹ nhàng và đợi cho việc đọc ổn định.
6. Sau khi hoàn thành việc làm sạch điện cực bằng nước cất, tắt máy bằng cách nhấn phím "ON / OFF".
7. Luôn luôn đậy nấp bảo vệ sau khi sử dụng.

*Hướng dẫn hiệu chuẩn:
1. Bật bút đo độ pH nước
2. Cho điện cực vào trong dung dịch chuẩn pH 6.86 (dưới nhiệt độ 25 ℃)
3. Sau khi chữ số ổn định, bấm nút "CAL" trong 5 giây (thiết bị đi vào trạng thái hiệu chuẩn tự động) chờ cho đến khi chữ số hiển thị là 6,86 pH, sau đó hoàn thành hiệu chuẩn pH 6.86
4. Làm sạch điện cực bằng nước thật sạch và làm khô bẳng giấy hay vải sạch, ngâm đầu điện cực trong dung dịch chuẩn chuẩn pH 4.00
5. Sau khi chữ số ổn định, nhấn nút "CAL" trong 5 giây, đợi cho đến khi chữ số là 4.00 pH, hoàn thành việc hiệu chuẩn pH 4.00
6. Làm sạch điện cực bằng nước thật sạch và lau sạch nước dự trên bút đo, đặt điện cực vào dung dịch chuẩn pH 9.18 cho đến ngày ổn định, dữ liệu sẽ là 9.17pH - 9.19pH, dữ liệu nằm trong phạm vi lỗi cho phép
7. Công việc hiệu chuẩn thiết bị này được hoàn thành sau tất cả các bước

*Lưu ý:
Bút đo pH cầm tay cần được hiệu chỉnh lại trong điều kiện sau
Thời gian không sử dụng hoặc sử dụng rất lâu sau khi hiệu chuẩn
Điện cực được sử dụng rất thường xuyên
Yêu cầu kiểm tra dung dịch với độ chính xác rất cao
Không nhấn nút "CAL" trong thời gian dài trong không khí, nếu không đồng hồ cần hiệu chuẩn lại

BẢO TRÌ ĐIỆN CỰC PH
Nếu điện cực sử dụng trong thời gian dài và điện cực tiếp xúc với không khí, sau đó hiển thị các giá trị chậm và không ổn định là do điện cực khô. Chỉ cần nhúng điện cực vào nước trong vài giờ.

title: Tone-Filter
description:
Protect your hearing. Keep the sound you love.
Most earplugs just make the world quieter.
Tone-Filters make it clearer — while still protecting your ears.
Whether you’re at a gig, on a building site, at a football match, studying, travelling, or simply trying to escape sensory overload, these earplugs lower harmful noise without turning everything into a muffled mess.
You hear what matters.
You lose what doesn’t.
18dB SNR protection. Real-world comfort. Zero compromise.
What makes Tone-Filters different?
🎵 Clear, Natural Sound
Our built-in acoustic filter reduces volume evenly across frequencies.
Music still sounds like music. Voices still sound like voices.
Just… safer.
No booming bass.
No muffled speech.
No distortion.
😌 All-Day Comfort
Made from ultra-soft, eco-friendly liquid silicone rubber, Tone-Filters are lightweight, flexible, and shaped for a secure, comfortable fit — even for long wear.
You forget they’re in.
Your ears don’t.
🌍 Protection for Real Life
Perfect for:
Concerts & festivals
Work environments & construction
Motorsport & sporting events
Studying & focus zones
Travel & commuting
Sensory overwhelm
Sleeping & downtime
One pair. Endless situations.
🖤 Sleek & Discreet
Minimal design that blends in anywhere — no bulky foam, no bright colours, no awkward looks.
Just clean, simple protection.
🔑 Pocket-Ready Carry Case
Every pair comes with a compact key-ring case, so your earplugs are always clean, protected, and ready to go.
Clip them to your keys.
Use them whenever life gets loud.
Why choose Jett Maxwell Tone-Filters?
✔ CE EN352-2 certified
✔ 18dB SNR hearing protection
✔ Comfortable, irritation-free fit
✔ Durable, eco-friendly materials
✔ Products from audiology professionals
Because your hearing matters.
Once it’s damaged, it doesn’t come back.
Tone-Filters make protecting it easy — and enjoyable.
Clearer sound.
Calmer ears.
Smarter protection.
Tone-Filter Noise Protection by Jett Maxwell.

title: Matchbox - House - I Wish You Lived Nearer
description:
A perfect gift for someone special, this super cute porcelain house from East of India is an adorable token of love or friendship.
The white porcelain house has painted black windows on the front is presented in a charming matchbox with a written message "I wished you lived nearer, just along the way. I wish you lived right here a thousand times a day" on the cover. A tender keepsake to treasure forever.
The house is white in colour and made from porcelain with a grey/beige coloured cardboard presentation box.
Please note this item is small. Matchbox measures 4.5 x 3.4 x 2cm.

title: POSCA MOP'R Set
description:
POSCA MOP'R features a round foam rubber tip and innovative barrel design for a generous application of color. With its truly ergonomic shape and semi-rigid design, it offers a new grip and a unique artistic experience. Create large drawings horizontally or vertically with the MOP'R. It can be used right side up for finer details or upside down for high link flow. Use MOP'R to create an endless variety of effects that are harder to achieve with other tips. It's perfect for creating splashes, stamps, spray effects, drips, highlights and more. Like all POSCA markers, MOP'R paint is non-toxic, water-based, mixable and colors can be over layered. Lines between 3 and 19mm can be achieved depending on the angle of the tip.
The 8-Color MOP'R Set includes: White, Yellow, Green, Light Blue, Pink, Red, Black And Blue.

description:
GPS ติดตามตำแหน่ง Real Time ป้องกันรถหาย ไม่ต้องชาร์ทแบตเตอรี่ แท้100% เครื่องติดตาม แจ้งเตือนเมื่อถูกถอดออก  ดูแบบหลายเครื่องได้ ดูย้อนหลังได้ 30 วัน
คุณสมบัติ GPS AIKA ST-902
1. สามารถดูพิกัด แบบ Real Time ลองรับ4G
2. สามารถดูพิกัด เส้นทางการเดินรถ ได้ 30 วัน
3. แจ้งเตือนออกนอกเส้นทาง
4.ดูความเร็วย้อนหลัง
5.SOS Center Number
6.แจ้งเตือนความเร็ว
7.เมนูภาษาไทย ผ่าน Browser
8.ดูผ่านแอพ Android และ IOS
9. ตั้งได้ว่าถ้าถอดเครื่องให้โทรมาหา
10.แจ้งเตือนเมื่อถูกถอดออก

การใช้งานเบื้องต้น  
1.การใช้งานเพียงนำซิมโทรศัพท์มือถือค่ายใดก็ได้  เปิดการใช้งานตั้งค่าให้สามารถเล่นอินเตอร์เน็ตได้ แล้วใส่เข้าไปในเครื่อง GPS 
2.นำ GPS ไปเสียบกับพอร์ท OBD2 ในรถยนต์ ทิ้งไว้15นาที
3.ให้โหลด APP (ฟรี) ได้ทั้งในมือถือระบบ Andorid และ IOS ค้นหาคำว่า AKHS  จากนั้นดาวน์โหลด App มาติดตั้งในมือถือ
4.ลงทะเบียนโดย Device ID ให้เอาตัวเลขข้างกล่องหรือข้างเครื่อง AKHS  ใส่ ส่วน Password ใส่คำว่า 123456 (password เป็นค่าเริ่มต้นจากโรงงาน) และ Login เข้าระบบ
5.ภายใน app จะแสดงจำนวนแบตเตอร์รี่คงเหลือเป็นเปอร์เซ็นต์ และมีหัวข้อต่างๆ ที่ควรทราบดังนี้
Live คือการดูการเคลื่อนไหวของเครื่องติดตามแบบสดๆ Real Time

***มีประกันเปลี่ยนสินค้าใหม่ 2 เดือน
เงื่อนไขการรับประกัน
1. สินค้าทุกชิ้นต้องอยู่ในสภาพสมบูรณ์ ไม่ ตก,หล่น,แตกหัก,โดนน้ำและการใช้งานผิดประเภท

Product Dimensions: 13 x 1 x 4 inches
Item Weight: 1.32 pounds

title: BetterBody Foods Organic Chia Seeds 2 lbs, 32 Oz, with Omega-3, Non-GMO, Gluten Free, Keto Diet Friendly, Vegan, Good Source of Fiber
description: Finding foods with lots of nutrients can be helpful for people who are trying to change their diet and live a better life. The word “chia” comes from the ancient Mayan word for strength. Why would the Mayans use such a powerful word for such a small seed? Well, chia seeds are loaded with nutrients such as fiber and omega-3 fatty acids. Our Organic Chia Seeds are nutrient powerhouses which is why they deserve to be associated with strength. They contain 37% of the daily recommended value of fiber to help the 97% of Americans who are fiber deficient. Because our chia seeds are flavor neutral and flavorless, you can add them to just about anything to get a boost without changing the taste of your food. Just mix our chia seeds with your favorite breakfast shake, smoothie, bread batter, or other food that could use a little extra crunch that your family will love! Use them as a pre- or post-workout boost with protein powders that you are already using. You can also sprinkle the seeds as a topping on yogurt, salads, or cereal for a satisfying snack! Our Organic Chia Seeds can also be used as an egg replacement when cooking or baking. Simply mix 1 tbs. of chia seeds with 3 tbs. of water, let sit for 5 minutes, and consume or bake immediately. Transform your living space with this luxurious wall-mounted pendulum clock, designed to add elegance and charm to any room. This uniquely shaped, richly colored wall pendulum clock features a silent sweeping second movement, running at only 20-30 decibels, providing a quiet and comfortable environment for you and your family.
Key Features:
Exquisite Appearance: The wall-mounted pendulum clock showcases lifelike animal feathers, creating a glamorous and elegant look.
High-Quality Material: Made from durable PVC, this clock is designed to withstand everyday use.
Silent Operation: The clock features a silent sweeping seconds movement, eliminating the annoying ticking sound.
Easy to Read: The larger digital clock dial allows for clear and easy reading of the time.
Easy to Clean: The smooth clock plate and painted finish make maintenance simple, requiring only a damp cloth to wipe.
Accurate Timing: The quartz oscillator inside the quartz sweep seconds movement vibrates at a set frequency, ensuring precise timekeeping.
Ideal Gift: This wall-mounted pendulum clock makes a thoughtful gift for Christmas, Thanksgiving, housewarming, or birthdays.

description:
Need some Austrian drip? You've come to the right place. These field jackets are in brand new, unissued condition and ready to wear.
They feature four large front pockets, a hideaway hood, full zip-up and button-up front with a storm flap, button-adjustable cuffs and an internal drawstring at the waist.
This field jacket was part of the Austrian Anzug 75 uniform, which was partially inspired by the US series of OG-107 uniforms dating from the 1960s. The M65 is a venerable design that has stood the test of time. It is still worn to this day by several militaries.
The Short & Sweet:
Genuine Austrian Bundesheer surplus
Unissued, brand new condition
May not come with Bundesheer patch
Cotton/polyester blend
Full-zip front with button storm flap
Button-flap chest and waist pockets
Button cuffs
Button epaulets
Internal drawstring at the waist for a snug fit
Parka length for extra coverage
Machine wash and dry

title: Slim 10000mAh Portable Charger, 22.5W Fast Charging Power Bank w/ Integrated Cables, 4 Outputs & 2 Inputs for iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel, iPad More
description:
Overview: Discover unparalleled convenience with our Slim 10000mAh Portable Charger, designed with integrated cables and versatile charging capabilities. Perfect for keeping your devices powered while on the move, this power bank eliminates the hassle of carrying extra cables and adapters.
Key Features:
Integrated Cables: Includes 2 built-in output cables—one for Lightning and one for USB-C—allowing you to charge a wide range of devices without needing extra cables. Compatible with iPhone, iPad, Samsung, USB-C smartphones, tablets, and Micro USB devices.
Multiple Outputs & Inputs: Boasts 4 outputs (2 built-in cables plus 2 extra USB outputs) and 2 inputs (Type-C and Micro USB). Charge up to 4 devices at once and recharge the power bank through either input for ultimate convenience.
Ultra-Slim Design: Measuring just 5.7'' x 2.68'' x 0.72'' and weighing only 0.52 lb, this power bank is as portable as your pocket. Its sleek design makes it easy to carry, making it perfect for travel.
Digital LED Display: Equipped with a clear LED display that shows the remaining battery percentage, so you’ll always know when it’s time to recharge.
Wide Compatibility: Universally compatible with popular devices such as iPhone 16/15/14/13/12/11/8 series, XR, XS Max, Samsung S22/S21/S20/A52/A32/Z Fold/Z Flip series, Google Pixel, OnePlus, Realme, Oppo, Xiaomi, Redmi, Vivo, LG, Motorola, and other Android devices featuring USB-C or Micro USB ports.
What’s Included:
1 x Portable Charger
1 x Type-C Charging Cable
1 x User Manual
This portable charger is essential for all your charging needs, ensuring you stay powered up wherever your adventures take you.

title: Mặt Nạ Ánh Sáng Halio PureGlow Ultralite Silicone LED Face Mask (Bảo Hành 12 Tháng) - Hàng Chính Hãng
description:
Cùng khám phá Mặt Nạ Ánh Sáng Halio PureGlow Ultralite Silicone LED Face Mask, với liệu pháp ánh sáng đỏ/hồng ngoại, ánh sáng xanh và ánh sáng vàng tiên tiến cùng 3 mức điều chỉnh hỗ trợ giảm thiểu nếp nhăn, các đốm đồi mồi, cải thiện làn da xỉn màu và không đều màu. Với trọng lượng chỉ 93 gram, đây là mặt nạ nhẹ nhất hiện có trên thị trường, đảm bảo sự thoải mái tuyệt vời khi đeo—hoàn hảo cho việc thư giãn, làm việc hoặc bất kỳ hoạt động hàng ngày nào. Với chỉ số chống nước và chống bụi IP67, mặt nạ luôn được đảm bảo vệ sinh, và dễ dàng vệ sinh với nước. Với 216 hạt đèn nhỏ, mặt nạ này giúp chăm sóc từng vấn đề da hiệu quả. Nâng tầm thói quen làm đẹp của bạn với thiết kế di động và có thể gập lại của mặt nạ ánh sáng Halio, mang lại sự tiện lợi và hiệu quả trong việc đạt được làn da rạng rỡ, trẻ trung chỉ với 10 phút sử dụng mỗi ngày.
Đặc điểm nổi bật:
- Liệu pháp ánh sáng đỏ và hồng ngoại 630nm-850nm: Kích thích sản sinh collagen, giảm nếp nhăn.
- Liệu pháp ánh sáng vàng 590nm: Giảm đỏ, làm sáng da, giảm thâm, tăng cường tuần hoàn máu cho da.
- Liệu pháp ánh sáng xanh dương 415nm: Diệt khuẩn gây mụn, làm sạch da.
- Siêu nhẹ: Chỉ nặng 93 gram, mang lại cảm giác thoải mái tối đa.
- Chống nước và bụi IP67: Có thể rửa sạch bằng nước an toàn.
- Thiết kế gấp gọn và di động: Dễ mang theo và cất giữ ở bất kỳ đâu.

Thông số kỹ thuật:
- Chứng nhận: ROHS, FC, CE
- Củ sạc: 5.0V-1.0A hoặc 5.0V-2.0A
- Trọng lượng sản phẩm: 93g
- Kích thước: Rộng 210mm x Dài 210mm x Cao 160mm
- Nguồn năng lượng: Đèn LED
- Bước sóng: Đỏ+ hồng ngoại (630-850nm), vàng 590nm, xanh: 415nm
- Số lượng đèn LED: 54 bóng đèn đỏ và 54 hồng ngoại, 54 bóng đèn xanh, 54 bóng đèn vàng
- Pin Lithium: 2600mAh

description:
Đồng hồ đo kỹ thuật số ANENG M118A Máy đo RMS thực 6000 Đếm Máy đo điện áp bóng bán dẫn AC / DC tự động
 
Mô tả: 
M118A là một máy đo kỹ thuật số quét tự động giá trị hiệu quả thực sự 3 5/6 chữ số.
M118A tự động nhận dạng và đo lường theo các tín hiệu điện áp / dòng điện / điện trở / v.v. đầu vào khác nhau.
M118A có các đặc tính của hiệu suất ổn định, độ chính xác cao và đọc rõ ràng.
M118A cũng có thêm các chức năng thuận tiện của đèn pin và kiểm tra điện áp không tiếp xúc,
M118A là một công cụ và dụng cụ lý tưởng phù hợp với các nhà máy, giảng dạy và những người đam mê điện tử.

Danh sách đóng gói: 
1 * Đồng hồ vạn năng kỹ thuật số
1 * Hướng dẫn kiểm tra
1 * Hướng dẫn sử dụng

title: hers Full Volume Conditioner
description:

In fact, BIOVOLUME 128™ has been shown to boost hair volume by up to 4X in just 5 washes.
Suitable for all hair types
Vegan and cruelty-free
Formulated without parabens and sulfates
6.4 oz/ 190mL
Start with Hers Full Volume Shampoo (sold separately)
